1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a computer system; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the computer system; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the computer system; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the computer system; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present using the computer system.

14. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisement messages using location reference codes comprising: - assessing a location reference code of a location description using a computer system; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the computer system; - generating an advertising message having the advertising reference code using the computer system; and - providing the advertising message for broadcast to navigation systems using the computer system.

25. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements comprising: - generating a message having an advertising reference code using a computer system; and - providing the message for broadcast to navigation systems using the computer system, wherein the advertising reference code comprises a substantially unique code that identifies at least a portion of an advertisement stored and displayed on a recipient device of the message.

27. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements via a traffic channel comprising: - generating a message having advertisements using a computer system; and - serially transmitting the message for broadcast to navigation systems via the traffic channel using the computer system.

29. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising: - receiving a message from a traffic supplier using a computer system, wherein the message contains a location reference and an advertising reference code; - assessing at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code using the computer system; and - presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code using the computer system. 

42. (Currently Amended) A memory comprising a data structure of traffic messages, wherein the data structure comprises: a first field having a location reference code associated with a location description on a road segment assigned by a traffic message supplier; and a second field having an advertising reference code associated with the location reference of the first field, wherein the advertising reference code is associated with at least one advertisement for output on a navigation system, the memory being a non-transitory computer-readable medium.
